summary: Frontend-focused MMS verification completed: rebuilt app, added focused Vitest MMS regression suite, and executed targeted browser checks. Core MMS library regressions passed; UI flow to Table MMS controls was not reliably reachable in automation; external data APIs returned 502 during Step 6 session.

ui_bugs.issue: Could not reliably open 'Table settings' -> table-mms-* controls in automation despite seeded valid table; no stable data-testid path for selecting table from plan view context flow.

integration_issues.issue: External preview returned 502 for /api/pvgis, /api/pvgis/tmy, and /api/solar/data-layers during test run.
Google Maps static map requests had empty key and returned 403; Places API also reported InvalidKey/NoApiKeys warnings.

issues: No horizontal overflow observed at 320/768/1024/1440 in tested state.

action_items: Investigate and fix 502 responses for /api/pvgis, /api/pvgis/tmy, /api/solar/data-layers on preview deployment.
Provide deterministic Step6 table-selection test hooks (data-testid on table target/context trigger) so table-mms-* and scene-mms-* workflows are automation-reachable.
Validate Google Maps key configuration in preview (Places + Static Maps).
After fixes, retest full browser MMS flow: Generate MMS, Basic/Advanced/Engineering tabs, scene inspector, undo/reload.
critical_code_review_comments: Scene3D.tsx is ~5800+ lines; exceeds maintainability threshold and should be split into focused modules.
Step6 table/MMS interaction path is hard to automate due missing stable selectors on key interaction targets; add data-testid per testing contract.
Build has React hook dependency warnings (Step2Roof, Step6Editor, Scene3D); verify memo dependencies to avoid stale derivations.
seed_data_creation: Created browser localStorage seeded project during UI automation only (test-session scoped, not committed to source).
context_for_next_testing_agent: New focused MMS regression file exists and passes (9 tests). Combined targeted MMS suite run passed 143/143. UI seeded Step6 run reached /wizard/6 and 3D view rendered meaningful non-blank model, but table settings/mms control path remained non-deterministic in automation. Use stronger selectors/hooks for table selection and rerun browser flow.
rca of the issue: RCA 1: Preview integration endpoints (/api/pvgis*, /api/solar/data-layers) returned 502 in browser console, causing data-service degradation in Step6 context. RCA 2: Step6 MMS panel is reachable through context-sensitive selection flow lacking deterministic selectors for table selection/open action, causing flaky/unreachable automation path. Mitigation: deploy endpoint fix + add explicit data-testid hooks on table target and 'Table settings' trigger states.
